feature_contract.goal: Preserve smoothly responsive exact-producer gameplay HUD location/size as icons approach and pass the original source-space edge; avoid a discontinuous snap of binocular anchors/zoom while preserving native center and non-gameplay overlays.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact R84 R30 gameplay HUD peripheral source-space easing only; never change F11/ESC/+TIME/GOAL, world markers, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: Canonical OutRunHudPeripheralText producers reach R84 R30 ScreenHud source-space anchor/size via OutRunVrHudEdge::PeripheralWeight and PeripheralAnchor.
The prior code returned full peripheral transform for |NDC|=1.20 then switched instantly to zero for |NDC|>1.20; anchors and sizing both used the same discontinuous weight.
A C1-continuous outgoing 1.00-1.20 envelope now returns smoothly to neutral; R33 draw and per-eye FOV remain unchanged.
subcomponents: Retain original C1 entry over 0.35-0.60 and full plateau 0.60-1.00; create smooth outbound transition to exactly neutral by 1.20.
Verify positive/negative symmetric C++ source-space numeric cases, outgoing gradient bounds, native 4:3/16:9/21:9 entry and source mutation negatives.
Use exact-SHA R84 Active game/host/package, R26_SAFE, Domain and impacted HUD/Full Source Gates before marking build verified.

diagnosis.original_evidence: At source HEAD, PeripheralWeight holds 1.0 to 1.20 inclusive and returns 0.0 for >1.20, while R30 applies this weight to both anchor and optical boost.
diagnosis.root_cause: A discontinuous visibility cutoff in exact gameplay HUD peripheral motion rather than an optical FOV or per-eye pose error.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Replace cutoff with bounded C1 smooth outgoing envelope over 1.0..1.2; retain central/plateau behavior and strict nonfinite/outside fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extend portable C++ smoke and Python source/mutation validator with bidirectional outgoing sweep, boundary and exact neutral cases.
diagnosis.evidence_limits: No physical Quest3/VDXR or game test; actual visible defect confirmation requires HMD runtime validation.
source_trace: OutRunHudPeripheralText original exact producer from hooks_uiscaling.cpp is submitted through the ScreenHud R84 R30 geometry path.
R30PeripheralAnchor and PeripheralWeight in stereo_renderer_r30.cpp share the original source-space NDC transition and are evaluated for binocular HUD anchor and boost.
R33 physical stereo draw replays the scoped semantic through left/right WVP and x64 OpenXR host composition; no other game/overlay routing was changed.
alternatives_rejected: Per-eye XR FOV, source texture decode and scene WVP are not implicated in the verified scalar jump at source-space 1.20; do not alter them.
An immediate cutoff outside the source boundary is not C1 continuous and contradicts the existing HUD transition easing contract.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R30 produces source-space HUD anchor and scale for exact peripheral producer, then R33 preserves binocular eye transforms and host; HMD actual presentation remains UNTESTED.

runtime_evidence: No physical Quest3/VDXR game execution in this task.
